M4 internet

Relay bridge / TCP + DNS

Browsers cannot open TCP sockets. Traffic is tunneled through the shared ws-unapi-relay service, which only permits public IPv4 hosts on common ports (23, 70, 80, 443, 2323).

Relay disabled
Opens the relay health page. Approve its certificate, then return here; reconnection is automatic.

For details see ws-unapi-relay.

One shared relay instance serves the 1983 and 1984 emulators. Run it with npm start from the 1983-msx-unapi-relay repository (defaults to ws://host:1983/unapi); or serve this page and the relay from one origin.

ROM

ROM slots

Upper ROM board / slots 0-31

Lower ROMOS_6128.ROM

16 KB ROM images (a 128-byte AMSDOS header is skipped automatically). Loading or ejecting a slot resets the machine. On the 6128 Plus, upper ROM reads come from the cartridge, so these slots are only visible on the CPC 6128.
